invoices.title: Dematerialization of RYDGE Conseil invoices
invoices.description: With RYDGE Conseil, benefit {noExtraCost} from the issuance of Firm invoices in {electronicFormat} and access to {digitalVault} containing all dematerialized invoices and credit notes, hosted with a trusted third party.
invoices.benefit1: The digital vault is a key step towards {mandatoryInvoice} and facilitates {digitalTransition} and compliance with upcoming legal obligations.
invoices.benefit2: Documents are stored in a {secure} environment that guarantees {durability}, {integrity} and {traceability} of invoices.
invoices.benefit3: Reduction of printing and contribution to our {csrPolicy}.
invoices.helpCenterLink: Help center: everything you need to know about your Rydge invoice Read the FAQ article
invoices.alertText1: Receiving invoices {dematerializedFormat} and accessing the {digitalVault} are essential elements for adopting good digital practices and ensuring an efficient and secure centralization of all the firm's documents.
